claim_being_audited: That certifying the current model release is policy-compliant because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and the warehouse robotics triage regression can be handled through explicit current-release disclosure rather than blocking certification.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses must be explicitly disclosed in current release documentation unless covered by an approved mitigation.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are supportive but not sufficient if the required disclosure or mitigation predicate is unresolved.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release documentation or model card showing the current evaluation results and explicit disclosure of the warehouse robotics triage limitation.
Provide any approved mitigation or reviewed risk-acceptance record that specifically covers the warehouse robotics triage regression for this release.
Provide the exact materiality determination or release decision record tying the subgroup weakness to the certification decision for the named launch use case.
specific_concerns: The governing policy requires that current release documentation reflect current evaluation results and disclose material segment weaknesses or show approved mitigation, but the available record only says the packet should do this, not that the documentation actually does.

The warehouse robotics triage slice is described as 1.5 percentage points below the warning threshold, which appears material for a named launch use case and therefore cannot be treated as background context.
Prior approval of the same model family and the informal monitoring comment are expressly insufficient substitutes for current documentation or reviewed risk acceptance under the policy text.
Because evidence access is limited to the actor summary, there is no admissible confirmation that the required disclosure language or mitigation approval exists in the current release materials.
unsupported_claims: Any claim that certification is already compliant on the present record without showing the current release documentation or approved mitigation for the subgroup regression.
Any claim that prior approval of the model family or informal post-launch monitoring notes satisfy current-release documentation obligations.
Any claim that the warehouse robotics triage weakness is adequately addressed absent explicit disclosure or approved mitigation.
